propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors in s4b, replication_errors in s5) declare neither alarm_actions nor ok_actions, causing OK→ALARM transitions to notify nobody despite being active and firing correctly.

Of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm resources in infra/terraform/, 11 wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn; the two without actions are the only exceptions to an established repo-wide convention.

A guard test (test_alarm_actions_terraform.py) was added to parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with anti-vacuity assertion and explicit documented opt-out markers to prevent future silent alarms.

The HCL changes merged to main (commit 24ec1e6d8a) but remained un-applied in AWS until a terraform apply executed by the operator, demonstrating the merge/apply gap documented in bug 1c39-96d4-8f9e-4d38.

A forced end-to-end test confirmed the applied alarms now transition to ALARM, trigger SNS publication to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn with confirmed email subscription (joeoakhart@navapbc.com), and return to OK state.
